name: feature-team
description: Alex designs; Dana (backend) and Mia (model) build in parallel; Quinn reviews and sends work back on rejection; Sam writes the release notes.

stages.name: Design
stages.promptTemplate:
Task: {task}

Produce an implementation plan split into two independent parts: (1) the .NET backend and (2) the ML model. For each part list files, steps and how it is verified.

stages.name: Backend
stages.promptTemplate:
Implement the backend part of the plan for: {task}

{input:design}

stages.name: Model
stages.promptTemplate:
Build and evaluate the ML model part of the plan for: {task}

{input:design}

stages.name: Review & test
stages.promptTemplate:
Review and test the backend and model work for: {task}

Approve only if both parts are correct and tested; otherwise list what must change.
